privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: Estatify.ai is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your data responsibly. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.
privacy.informationCollectionText: We collect information you provide directly, such as name, email, and property details when you use our services. We also collect usage data and analytics information to improve our services.
privacy.dataUsageText: We use your information to provide our services, personalize your experience, and communicate with you. We may use aggregated data for analytics and service improvement.
privacy.dataSecurityText: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
privacy.userRightsText: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information. You may also opt out of certain data collection practices.
privacy.changesText: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes and indicate when they become effective.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.introduction: This Cookie Policy explains how Estatify.ai uses cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience on our website.
cookies.whatAreCookiesText: Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help us recognize you and remember your preferences.
cookies.howWeUseText: We use cookies for essential functionality, analytics, and personalization. Essential cookies are required for our services to function properly.

categories.analyticsText: Help us understand how you use our site

cookies.managingText: You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. However, disabling certain cookies may affect site functionality.
cookies.thirdPartyText: We may use third-party services that set cookies on our behalf for analytics and marketing purposes.
cookies.updatesText: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.
